title: Bosun Trice Project Contract v1
description: Machine-readable schema contract for a Trice (Realm 2: Tasks & GTD) project note's YAML frontmatter. A project is a container grouping related `$trice:task/v1` entries toward an outcome.

schema.description: Frontmatter type tag identifying this entity as a Trice project, schema version 1.

id.description: Stable project identifier (ULID/UUID), independent of file path.

area.description: GTD area of focus this project belongs to.

target_date.description: Target completion date, ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tags.description: User tags associated with the project.

task_count.description: Cached count of tasks with `project` equal to this entity's `id`. Disposable projection; recomputed from task frontmatter, never authoritative.
